definitions.primary: Per business sum over transport legs of continuous finish minus first actual planning attempt; retries included, EBS storage excluded.
definitions.canonical_elapsed: Per business sum of leg finish minus canonical pass_time; includes all preplanning and planning delay, excludes inter-leg storage.
definitions.incomplete: All full-population duration/count-distribution metrics null. Observed completion counts and explicitly labelled deadline observations are diagnostics.
definitions.retry_counts: Only explicit counters; HCA missing per-bag counters remain null. Planning wait seconds are separately reported.
definitions.system_objective: Report fixed-window completions, backlog and hourly cumulative completion alongside mean full-population user THT; no per-bag winner selection.
definitions.timing: Native API and Java whole-run wall times have different scopes; no speed ratio is computed.
